description: Northern Territory Geochronology Uranium-Lead (UPb) Dataset is a dataset listed in Northern Territory Government open data portal (data.nt.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Mining and Energy. This dataset comprises uranium-lead (U-Pb) age determinations (reported in millions of years) and isotope ratios for zircon and monazite from rocks from the Northern Territory. Supplementary lutetium-hafnium (Lu-Hf) and oxygen (O) isotope ratios are also provided for zircon from selected samples. Coverage: Northern Territory. The portal files it under the publisher Mining and Energy. Its tags are Geoscientific Information. It offers 5 resource(s) in csv, html, kml, mapinfo tab, shp. The portal shows 2023-09-11 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-nt-government-open-data-portal.
